latestVersion.changelog:
AI Subtitle Jellyfin — Initial release

- Generate AI-powered subtitles for Jellyfin-compatible videos (MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV up to 500MB)
- Automatic cloud processing and export in 1080p MP4 format with subtitles; SRT export supported
- Simple onboarding with free token and session setup; 100 credits valid for 7 days
- Clear user prompt mappings for upload, export, balance, and status actions
- Detailed API integration, error handling, and instructions for frontend-to-backend interactions
- Designed for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative workflows within Jellyfin environments
